<!-- pr-reviewer: a24ed4c45392aa36660692403f2ab6052e579136 -->
**Needs changes before merge.** The post change is right, but it makes one golden that merged after your branch stale.

**What looks good**
- The `sRpm > 0` gate matches the rule `fanuc.cps` already uses, in all five posts (`haas.cps:308`, `tormach.cps:~264`, `sinumerik.cps`, `mazak.cps`, `heidenhain.cps`). Heidenhain's `spindleWait = false` is now correctly outside the gate.
- Prime Directive, can a CUTTING section post without a spindle start? I found no way. `Tool::is_sane` (`crates/tools/src/tools.rs:224`) refuses rpm <= 0 and non-finite values, and it is enforced where a tool enters: `commands/tool.rs:49` (create), `:93` (`ChangeTool`), `tool_import.rs:67`, `tool_library.rs:110`, and project load in `project/validate.rs:139`. So an rpm-0 cutter cannot arrive from a command, an import or a project file. The only rpm-0 source is `posting.rs:765`, which forces 0 for `ToolKind::Probe`, and `tool_law.rs:92` mounts probe tools only on the Probe operation. No other path builds the post's Dump with an rpm (checked `rpm:` in the non-test sources).
- Cutting output is unchanged: the conformance and NC goldens other than the one below still match.
- Provenance and process look fine: `Changelog:` line, `Fixes #523`, a decisions file, no `CHANGELOG.md` edit, no build.rs, scripts, `.github` or dependency changes.

**Local results (PR merged with current upstream/main, clean merge, no conflicts)**
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `probe_spindle` (new) | 2 passed |
| `conformance` | 6 passed |
| `tormach_post` | 10 passed |
| `posting` | 17 passed |
| `fanuc_post`, `inverted_post`, `inverted_probe`, `probe_op`, `probe_pick`, `probe_reach`, `tormach_safe_retract`, `tormach_machines`, `setup_mounts_post`, `lathe_post`, `post_not_judged` | all passed |
| `probe_guard` | 4 passed, **1 failed** |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

```
---- tormach_writes_protected_moves_as_g38_3_with_a_trip_test ----
golden .../tests/golden/nc/tormach/probe_guard_moves.nc is stale; regenerate with WRITE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test
  left (golden): ...G43 H7\nS0 M3\nG0 X-7 Y5\n...
  right (posted): ...G43 H7\nG0 X-7 Y5\n...
```

**Requested before merge**
1. `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/tormach/probe_guard_moves.nc` (added by #500's tormach probe positioning, which has since merged to main) still contains `S0 M3`. This is exactly the output this PR removes, so the golden must lose that line. Run `WRITE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p camcraft-app --test probe_guard`, check the diff is only the `S0 M3` line, and push. The PR body says #500 "should merge after this", but it is already on main; please merge `upstream/main` into the branch and re-run the probe suites.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- A rpm-0 stream reaching a post from outside the app (a hand-fed or legacy CL stream) now posts no spindle start and no warning, where before it posted `S0 M3`. The app cannot produce one for a cutter, so this is fine, but a post-side warning for a non-probe section with rpm 0 would make it visible.
- No UI suites run: no UI change.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 822bf6adcaf2a252b8a75fc59d147b20991ab04f -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- The `sRpm > 0` gate is applied in all five posts (`haas.cps:309`, `tormach.cps:311`, `sinumerik.cps:326`, `mazak.cps:303` block, `heidenhain.cps:271-279`) and matches the rule `fanuc.cps` already uses. These are the only spindle-start sites in those five posts (grep for `M3`/`MOTON`).
- Heidenhain: `spindleWait = false` now sits outside the gate, and the `TOOL CALL` drops its `S` word only at rpm 0. A cutting section posts the same blocks as before.
- Golden diff is exactly the intended change: `golden/nc/tormach/probe_guard_moves.nc` loses the single `S0 M3` line and nothing else. No other golden is touched by the PR.
- Programs with a cutter (rpm > 0) post byte-identically: every NC golden and the conformance suite pass unchanged on the merged tree. `a_cutting_section_still_starts_its_spindle_on_every_mill_post` pins it on all six mill posts.
- Prime Directive: a cutting section cannot lose its spindle through this, since `Tool::is_sane` refuses rpm <= 0 (checked in the previous review round). Clean-room, provenance line, `Changelog:`, `Fixes #523` and a decisions file are all present. No `build.rs`, scripts, `.github`, dependency or `CHANGELOG.md` changes.

**Local results** (PR head merged with current upstream/main, clean merge, no conflicts)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run` | built |
| probe_spindle (new) | 2 passed |
| probe_guard / probe_op / inverted_probe | 5 / 11 / 8 passed |
| conformance, posting | 6 / 17 passed |
| tormach_post, tormach_machines, tormach_safe_retract | 10 / 5 / 4 passed |
| fanuc_post, program_entry, program_comments, cli | 11 / 9 / 4 / 7 passed |
| heidenhain_block_form, heidenhain_arc_centre, sinumerik_safe_retract | 4 / 2 / 3 passed |
| inverted_post, inverted_equivalence, inverted_axis_display | 15 / 2 / 5 passed |
| arc_planes, control_comp, drill_rplane, vertical_arc_entry, wear_comp | 8 / 5 / 8 / 3 / 5 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

I ran every app suite that references one of the touched posts, not the whole workspace. The UI was not run, since nothing in it changed.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `probe_spindle.rs` uses `panic!`/`expect` in its helpers; that is test code, so fine.
- The PR body still says "#500 should merge after this" and "every golden is unchanged"; the later comment explains both are out of date now that #500 is on main and this PR carries its golden. The decisions file says the same "#500 should merge after this" line, which is harmless but stale.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
